roles.core/secp256k1.cpp: Scalar reference implementation of Secp256k1 (39 KB, largest core file)
roles.core/secp256k1-*.hpp: SIMD optimized elliptic curve arithmetic kernels (SSE4, AVX2, AVX-512, ARM64)
roles.core/secp256k1_fleet.hpp: Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) fleet layout for vectorized Kangaroo operations (1024 lanes)
roles.core/secp256k1_reduce.hpp: Modular reduction constants for field prime
roles.core/hash.cpp: SHA-256 + RIPEMD-160 multi-ISA dispatch with runtime kernel selection
roles.core/sha256-*.cpp: SIMD optimized SHA-256 hashing (SSE4, AVX, AVX2, AVX-512, ARM64 Crypto)
roles.core/ripemd160-*.cpp: SIMD optimized RIPEMD-160 hashing (SSE4, AVX2, NEON)
roles.core/adaptive_filter.cpp: AdaptiveCuckooFilter dispatcher and base management with runtime ISA selection
roles.core/adaptive_filter_*.cpp: SIMD optimized Cuckoo Filter batch lookup kernels with manual prefetching
roles.core/bitcoin_format.cpp: Bitcoin address formatting: WIF encoding, Base58Check, pubkey compression (renamed from core/address.cpp in Phase 11)
roles.engine/kangaroo.cpp: Pollard's Kangaroo search engine with fleet SIMD, distinguished points, trap persistence (39 KB)
roles.engine/bsgs.cpp: Baby-step Giant-step search engine with GLV decomposition
roles.engine/address.cpp: Hybrid multi-mode address search with endomorphism fusion and chunked processing (44 KB)
roles.engine/app.cpp: Shared engine initialization (hardware detection, banner, target loading)
roles.system/hardware.cpp: CPU feature detection, cache topology, NUMA detection, thread affinity (pin_thread_to_core, pin_thread_to_node)
roles.system/checkpoint.cpp: Binary checkpoint persistence with CRC32 integrity validation
roles.system/cli.cpp: CLI argument parsing for all 3 engine modes
roles.system/types.hpp: Core type definitions: HardwareInfo, CommonOptions, CheckpointState
roles.modulos/*.cpp: Main entry points for engine binaries (thin wrappers)
roles.tests/crypto_test.cpp: 73 unit tests covering EC, hashing, encoding, checkpoint roundtrip
